item.title: Collaborative-Robot Automotive Digital Twin and Edge Vision AI
item.description:
Project resources

The team presentation and related public robot-HMI implementation.

  • Related GitHub repositorygithub.com/HeungJAELEE/Busan_Robot
  • Automotive Digital Twin team report/docs/Robot_Digital_Twin.pdf

Only values directly visible in the team PDF are treated as measured: F1 1.00 and 0.877, plus a Pi5 5 FPS to Pi5+Hailo-10H 18 FPS comparison. The repository is a related PC-HMI extension, not a one-to-one copy of the complete team deliverable.

Project at a glance

This education team project connected a three-Indy7 miniature automotive assembly flow with QR product identity, YOLOv11 inspection, PLC/SCADA, MySQL/MES, a digital-twin view, and Raspberry Pi 5/Hailo-10H edge inference.
